## What the project addresses
The Canonical Protocol is a software-governance framework for AI-assisted engineering. It focuses on architectural discipline, explicit change procedures, separation of layers, justified complexity, cognitive sovereignty, AI-agent coordination, evaluation-driven development, code provenance and traceability.

Relevant discovery terms include:
software governance; AI-assisted software engineering; AI coding governance; agentic coding guardrails; software architecture governance; cognitive debt; cognitive sovereignty; code provenance; evaluation-driven development; AI agents; architectural integrity; software engineering guardrails; vibe coding.
